enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Roll onto back. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth, and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Wash face. Dry face. Get dressed. Comb hair. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out cereal and bowl. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Eat breakfast. Drink water. Rinse bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone for shift updates and setting up the home workstation, since the transport strike prevents commuting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read shift updates. Put down phone. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Adjust chair. Log in to computer. Open work applications.

enriched_activities.activity: Joining the virtual team handover meeting and reviewing the day's telehealth appointment list on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open video conferencing software. Join meeting. Greet team: 'Good morning, everyone.' Listen to handover. Take notes. Mute microphone. Unmute. Ask question. Share screen. Review appointment list. Open calendar. Check patient names. Make notes. Close meeting. Open appointment list. Review schedule.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely: conducting telehealth consultations and updating patient records on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Open patient record. Start video call. Greet patient. Ask about symptoms. Listen. Take notes. Provide advice. End call. Update patient record. Type notes. Save record. Close record. Open next patient record. Repeat.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Prepare sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Rinse plate. Put plate in dishwasher. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, stretching, and watching the news on the TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel to news. Watch news. Stand up. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Sit down. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote clinical work: follow-up telehealth calls and documentation on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open patient list. Call patient. Discuss follow-up. Take notes. End call. Update record. Type. Save. Open next patient. Call patient. Discuss follow-up. Take notes. End call. Update record.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding after the workday with light stretching and quiet relaxation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Lean back. Close eyes. Take deep breaths. Open eyes. Stand up. Reach arms up. Bend forward. Sit down. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Put down magazine.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Plate food.

Sit at table. Serve food onto plate. Pick up fork. Eat. Pick up glass. Drink water. Put down fork. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue eating. Finish meal. Push plate away. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Close dishwasher. Wipe table. Wipe counters. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing on the computer for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Browse websites. Read articles. Watch TV. Close laptop. Put down laptop. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch movie. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and doing evening personal care
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Wash face. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, watching TV and reading on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Read article. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Roll onto back. Sigh. Continue sleeping.
